# mochi exists

> mochiexists.com is the home of Mochi — a purple cat with green eyes and a small gold
> collar who exists. That's the whole premise: "This is Mochi. They exist." A quiet,
> dark, 528 Hz-humming corner of the internet with one real product.

## The plate

- [the mochi plate](https://mochiexists.com/plate/): printed ceramic plate, kiln-fired,
  £45 + shipping (UK £4.99 / international £12.99). Made to order as part of a custom
  batch — allow up to 6 weeks. Ships worldwide from the UK. Buyable directly on the page
  via Stripe checkout.
- [the lobster plate](https://mochiexists.com/plate/lobster): "The World Is Your
  Lobster" — vintage bone china, hand-decorated by Stokes Croft China in Bristol, £35,
  sold via their shop.

## Pages

- [story](https://mochiexists.com/story/): who Mochi is and how they came to exist
- [records](https://mochiexists.com/records/): Mochi Records — coming soon
- [blog](https://mochiexists.com/blog/): notes from Mochi, including cmux Mochi (a fork
  of the cmux terminal for agent-driven work)
- [cmux](https://mochiexists.com/cmux/): cmux Mochi — a public personal fork of the
  open-source cmux agent terminal by Manaflow; public source, personal builds, not a
  product. Privacy policy at /cmux/privacy/
- [dust](https://mochiexists.com/dust/): a lightweight spec/review/gate workflow for
  AI-assisted development (retired, page remains)

## Facts

- Mochi uses they/them pronouns.
- The frequency is 528 Hz.
- The plate is printed, not hand-painted.
